title: Available Transfer Amount on a Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Sizing clause.** A customer who asks to move everything they can out of the personal balance of a Pocketwire Personal Account to their linked bank sends one standard cash-out whose amount is the available transfer amount. The available transfer amount is the account's ledger balance at the moment of the transfer, rounded to the cent (half up). The amounts kept back on the balance are added together into one total, which is taken off the ledger balance once, the result never falling below 0.00.

**Terms used**

- *Ledger balance at the moment of the transfer* — the personal-account ledger balance recorded on the account when the transfer is sized.
- *Amounts kept back* — the total kept back is 0.00 when nothing is kept back.

**Worked figures (hypothetical balances)**

| Ledger balance | Total kept back | Available transfer amount |
|---|---|---|
| 842.17 | 0.00 | 842.17 |
| 1500.00 | 300.00 and 150.25, together 450.25 | 1049.75 |
| 200.00 | 350.00 | 0.00 — the result never falls below 0.00 |

The whole total kept back is taken off in a single step: in the second row the 450.25 comes off the 1500.00 once, and the transfer is one standard cash-out of 1049.75.
